categories.main_business_segments: The company operates in the pet food industry with primary business segments including pet chewing foods (rawhide and plant-based chews), nutritional meat treats, pet dry food, wet food, and new-type main grain products. The company also operates pet product brands and provides related services. It serves both domestic Chinese market and international markets through different business models.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed advanced production technologies including rawhide chewing food purification and production technology, collagen fiber composite technology, liquid smoking technology, animal-plant protein mixed preparation technology, pet food embossing technology, freeze-drying technology for pet food, and collagen protein pet food production technology. The company operates multiple production bases with electronic beam irradiation sterilization lines for quality control and has established research institutes for product development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves pet owners globally, with primary customers including major international pet food brand companies, channel distributors, and retailers in developed markets. Domestically, customers include regional distributors, batch wholesalers, pet chain hospitals, and pet supermarkets. The company's products are designed for dogs and cats as companion animals, with the domestic market showing faster growth than overseas markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with production bases in China (Wenzhou, Taizhou), Vietnam, Cambodia, and New Zealand. It serves major markets including the United States, Europe, Canada, and increasingly the Chinese domestic market. The company has established international operations across multiple continents, with overseas assets representing a significant portion of total assets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream of the pet food supply chain as a manufacturer and producer. Upstream suppliers include grain processing enterprises, livestock farming, aquatic product processing, and food additive suppliers. Downstream customers include brand companies, commercial distributors, and retail enterprises. The company also operates downstream through its own brands and direct-to-consumer channels.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus is on the 'One Body Two Wings' development strategy, emphasizing self-owned brand building and global operations. R&D priorities include developing functional pet food products, improving raw material utilization, advancing production automation, and creating new main grain products. The company invests in product innovation, process improvement, and technology advancement to maintain competitive advantages in health-functional pet food.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of pet food and related products. Revenue comes from two main channels: ODM (Original Design Manufacturing) mode serving international brand companies and distributors, and OBM (Original Brand Manufacturing) mode selling self-owned brands domestically and internationally. The company also generates revenue through direct sales and distribution partnerships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading Chinese pet food manufacturer and a global leader in pet chewing food products. Major international competitors include Mars and Nestlé in mature markets. Domestically, the company competes with numerous emerging brands. The company differentiates itself through advanced technology, quality control, global manufacturing capabilities, and increasingly through self-owned brand development.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company generated revenue of 1.411 billion yuan in 2023, down 18.51% from 1.732 billion yuan in 2022, primarily due to overseas market destocking. Net profit attributable to shareholders was negative 11.09 million yuan in 2023 compared to positive 127.12 million yuan in 2022. Total assets reached 2.936 billion yuan at year-end 2023. The company is in a growth phase with significant international operations and expanding domestic market presence.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, health-functional pet food products with advanced production technology and strict quality control. Differentiation includes proprietary technologies in rawhide processing, collagen fiber composites, and freeze-drying methods. The company offers diverse product categories from chewing foods to premium main grains, with particular strength in functional pet nutrition. Self-owned brands like Jueyuan and Haoshijia focus on differentiated, high-quality products meeting evolving consumer demands for scientific pet nutrition.
